description: This file defines the CommandProcessingResult class, which encapsulates the result of processing a command within the Apache Fineract project. It includes various identifiers, metadata, and status information related to a command execution, such as resource IDs, external IDs, change maps, and transaction control flags.

classes.name: CommandProcessingResult
classes.description: Represents the successful result of a REST API call that results in processing a command. It holds identifiers, change details, transaction information, and external references relevant to the command's outcome.

methods.name: fromCommandProcessingResult
methods.description: Creates a new CommandProcessingResult instance based on an existing result, with an optionally replaced resourceId.

methods.name: fromDetails
methods.description: Constructs a CommandProcessingResult using detailed parameters including command identifiers, resource identifiers, external IDs, and additional metadata.

methods.name: commandOnlyResult
methods.description: Creates a CommandProcessingResult with only a commandId, indicating a result with no resource or change details.

methods.name: resourceResult
methods.description: Generates a result with a resourceId, optional commandId, and optional change map.

methods.name: withChanges
methods.description: Creates a result containing a resourceId and change details.

methods.name: empty
methods.description: Returns an empty CommandProcessingResult with all fields null.

methods.name: getChanges
methods.description: Returns the changes map if not empty; otherwise, null.

methods.name: hasChanges
methods.description: Checks whether there are any recorded changes.

methods.name: isRollbackTransaction
methods.description: Indicates whether the transaction should be rolled back.

methods.name: setExternalIdOrNull
methods.description: Helper method to normalize ExternalId objects, returning null if empty or null.
